title: Site topic guides – Squarespace Help Center

facts.fact: Squarespace's live chat support runs Monday through Friday, 4:00AM to 8:00PM EST.
Squarespace states that it currently offers live chat support in English only.
facts.quote: We currently offer live chat support in English only.

facts.fact: Squarespace's refund request form says the team will respond within 2 business days.
Squarespace says its identity verification process should take about five minutes and uses Plaid software.
facts.quote: Our identity verification process should only take you about five minutes.

facts.fact: For account recovery, Squarespace requires a bank statement showing the most recent Squarespace charge, except for two-factor authentication issues.
facts.quote: Please attach a bank statement that shows the bank header, bank accountholder name, and the most recent Squarespace charge.

facts.fact: Bank statements submitted for account recovery must be in PDF format and be official statements downloaded from the bank.
facts.quote: Files must be in PDF format and official statements downloaded from your bank.

facts.fact: If multiple websites are entered in an account recovery request, Squarespace asks for statements showing the most recent charge associated with every site.
facts.quote: If you entered multiple websites above, attach statements showing the most recent charge associated with every site.

facts.fact: Squarespace's tax exemption certificate upload accepts .pdf, .png, and .jpeg file formats.
For government ID uploads in the identity-related form, files must be .jpg or .png.
facts.quote: Ensure your files are .jpg or .png so we can view them

facts.fact: The .AU domain registry requires registrants to provide a copy of an Australian government-issued ID number, such as a driver's license, passport, or birth certificate.
facts.quote: you are required to provide a copy of an Australian government-issued ID number (such as a Driver's License, Passport, or Birth Certificate)

facts.fact: Squarespace's support page says the legacy Squarespace 5 platform has its own separate Help Center.
facts.quote: For questions about the legacy Squarespace 5 platform, please visit its Help Center:
